title: Contrastive Training of Complex-Valued Autoencoders for Object Discovery

layout.note: A narrow vertical column at the left stacks the output maps, the Decoder, the key glyphs, the Encoder and the input scene; a large 3 x 5 grid fills the middle with the anchor at its left edge, and the anchor, positive and negative feature boxes sit in columns at the right, joined by curved arrows.

lesson: Explain a pair-sampling scheme for a contrastive loss on a real grid of items: show the model's output maps with a patch grid and the anchor cell marked X, lay the candidate cells out as a coloured grid, outline the sampled ones in the role colour, and link them to labelled boxes with a green plus arrow and red minus arrows.
